component.name: MyTag
component.summary: Edit tags and cover art on your FLAC and MP3 music files

description.p: MyTag is a simple, focused tag and cover art editor for FLAC and MP3 music files on Linux. Load a single file or a whole folder of albums at once, see everything in a clean list, and edit as many tracks together as you like — MyTag always shows you when the selected tracks disagree on a value, so you never overwrite something by accident.

ul.li: Edit Title, Artist, Album, Album Artist, Year, Genre, Track Number and Disc Number, for one or many files at once (FLAC, MP3, M4A/MP4, Ogg Vorbis and Opus)
Pick a cover image from your computer, paste one from the clipboard, drag and drop it onto the app, or search for one online (MusicBrainz and iTunes) right from the app
Resize covers to any size you choose, keeping their original proportions (or matched to a square when the selected tracks have different covers)
Rename files from their tags with a configurable pattern, preserving original file extensions
Identify an untagged or mislabeled track by audio fingerprint (AcoustID)
Check file stream integrity, and fill in missing covers across a whole loaded library
A per-track indicator flags anything missing a cover, year or genre
Quickly auto-number a set of tracks, or revert unsaved changes back to what's on disk
Search and filter a large list of loaded tracks
Light, dark, or system-matched theme, and an adjustable interface scale
Available in Spanish, English and Catalan
Nothing is written to disk until you choose to save

description.p: MyTag focuses purely on tags and cover art — no playback, no library management, just a clean way to get your audio collection's metadata right.

description.p: Expanded audio format support, automatic integrity verification, and UI refinements:

ul.li: Expanded format support: full metadata and cover art editing for M4A/MP4 (AAC and Apple Lossless/ALAC), Ogg Vorbis (.ogg) and Opus (.opus).
Automatic file integrity check on import: background async verification across all supported formats.
Visual error indicators: corrupt files display an error icon with tooltip details and sort to the top of the table.
Corrupt file warning dialog with options to review or remove corrupt files immediately.
Integrity check toggle in Preferences dialog under File Options.
Dedicated Disc Number column enabled by default in the song table with natural numeric sorting.
Application title bar displays the program name and active version number.
Python 3.14 compatibility and dynamic sitelib packaging for Fedora 44.

description.p: Customizable column management, drag-and-drop column reordering, and cross-distribution icon compatibility:

ul.li: Interactive drag-and-drop column reordering in the song table with real-time visual drop indicators.
Full column customization: toggle visibility, adjust widths, and preserve custom column order across sessions.
Dedicated column configuration menu and header context menu to easily toggle columns and restore defaults.
Adaptive table layout: last visible column dynamically expands to fill remaining panel width while prior columns remain fixed and cleanly resizable.
Bundled symbolic SVG icons ensuring complete, reliable rendering across all Linux distributions, including pure Debian with standard Adwaita.

description.p: Inspector panel redesign, zero-scroll compact layout, and inline cover resizing:

ul.li: Redesigned inspector panel with album cover art at the top as the visual anchor.
Zero-scroll compact layout ensuring all 8 metadata fields and album cover are simultaneously visible without scrollbars.
Direct inline editing of cover dimensions directly beneath the artwork with automatic aspect-ratio preservation.
Unified compact file status banner in the tag editor.
Refined padding and modern Libadwaita styling throughout the side panel.

description.p: Major UI modernization, context menu, unified inspector, and Flatpak fpcalc support:

ul.li: Unified two-pane layout: merged tag and cover inspector on the right, giving more than 70% window space to the track list.
New Album column in track list with proportional column widths and integrated search filtering.
Right-click context menu on track table rows providing immediate access to all track operations.
Dedicated Revert changes toolbar button replacing the secondary more menu.
Built-in AcoustID client key with zero-configuration fingerprinting.
Flatpak includes chromaprint (fpcalc) and host music library access out of the box.
Cleaner cover dimensions entry fields without stepper buttons.
Focused completeness warnings checking only essential fields (Title, Artist, and Cover).
Feature Guide dialog structured with detailed cards for all features and workflows.
Configurable track number zero-padding and renaming pattern in Preferences.

description.p: Batch audio fingerprinting and multi-track value picker:

ul.li: Batch AcoustID fingerprinting: scan and identify multiple audio tracks at once with progress reporting and alternative release candidate selection.
Multi-track value picker: view all existing distinct tag values across a selection and apply any value to all selected tracks with a single click.
Fixed AcoustID metadata resolution and smart prioritization for original studio album releases.

description.p: Full MP3 audio support alongside FLAC, and typography refinements:

ul.li: Native MP3 audio tagging via ID3v2.4 frames (TIT2, TPE1, TALB, TPE2, TDRC, TCON, TRCK, TPOS).
Embedded APIC cover art support for MP3 (load, replace, resize, and remove).
Audio stream integrity verification for both MP3 and FLAC.
Audio fingerprinting (AcoustID) and automatic tag extraction for MP3 and FLAC.
Extension-aware pattern renaming preserving original format (.flac or .mp3).
Streamlined typography matching native desktop scaling and Nautilus font metrics.

description.p: Major release featuring comprehensive visual modernization and packaging overhaul:

ul.li: Responsive track table layout with a fixed track number column and auto-expanding artist and title columns occupying full panel width.
Pixel-perfect UI alignment with balanced margins, centered cover action buttons, and cohesive visual hierarchy across light and dark themes.
Enhanced dialogs with clear icon-and-label action buttons.
Robust audio fingerprinting pipeline with full 24-bit and multi-channel FLAC decoding via Chromaprint / fpcalc.
Official binary packages for Flatpak, Debian/Ubuntu (.deb), Fedora/RHEL (.rpm), and Arch Linux (.pkg.tar.zst).

description.p: Bug-fix release, plus a first Arch Linux package: drag & drop from external file managers now works on Hyprland and other wlroots compositors, saving after renaming files from tags no longer fails, track list columns can be resized freely and are reordered (Nº, Artist, Title), cover resizing is a directly editable width/height (including a square crop when the selected tracks have different covers), and CSV export was removed.

Context menus on the cover art, a new app icon, a light/dark theme override, an About dialog, a keyboard shortcuts window, drag & drop for cover images, audio fingerprint identification (AcoustID), FLAC integrity checking, batch cover fill-in across an album collection, a per-track completeness indicator, CSV export, and renaming files from tags.
